Name: (CP)European-style garden building components
Author: umganil
Description:
[b][center][size=4]Instructions for Player:[/size][/center][/b][list]
[list]
[*]This is a mod containing a variety of European-style garden building components, including the original designs and four corresponding floral versions. In theory, all of these components—regardless of style—can be assembled like simple building blocks into any shape to fit different terrains.
[*]If you’re patient and also using [b]Precise Furniture (23488)[/b], the possibilities for building become even greater.
[*]Due to the large number of map recolor mods and time constraints, I’ve only prepared three main recolor categories. All five styles, including the original, have three recolor options: [b]light[/b], [b]middle[/b], and [b]dark[/b].
[list]
[*][b]light[/b] corresponds to lighter map recolors, e.g.,[b] Blue Grass Recolor (10635)[/b]
[*][b]middle[/b] corresponds to neutral map recolors, e.g., [b]Soft Slow Seasons (23095)[/b]
[*][b]dark[/b] corresponds to darker map recolors, e.g., [i][b]DaisyNiko’s Earthy Recolour (5255)[/b][/i]
[/list][*]The mod package defaults to the [b]middle[/b] recolor. Due to time and effort constraints, I have not (and will not for now) implement recolor-switching code. Instead, both [b]light[/b] and [b]dark[/b] recolors are included in the mod package, so you can manually replace the assets in the folder as needed (make sure the filenames in the assets folder remain [b]Furniture[/b]!).
[*]This mod is the public standard version and does not include the more elaborate large components shown in Image 3. These components will be part of my Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) fan-exclusive content and will only be released on my Xiaohongshu account.
[/list][b][center][size=3]
How to Obtain These Furniture Items:[/size][/center][/b][list]
[*]Purchase the furniture catalog from Robin.
[*]Obtain through the Happy Home Designer (19675) list.
[*]Obtain via CJB
[/list][list=1]


Welcome to follow me on RedBook (Xiaohongshu) @山茶花与紫丁香，Some of my non-furniture mods will also be shared here.
If you enjoy my mods, perhaps consider treating me to a cup of cofe?or please give me a thumbs up; it's very important to me. ;v;
I also accept inquiries for custom mod commissions.
Thank you so much! 
[/list][/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][center][size=4][b]使用说明：[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]这是一组包含了各种欧式园林建筑部件的模组，包含原始款式和对应的四种有花款式。理论上，所有这些部件不分款式都可以像搭建简易积木那样搭建成任意形状，以适应不同地形。
[*]如果你有耐心并且使用了Precise Furniture（23488），那么可搭建的可能性能进一步提升。
[*]由于地图着色类太多，出于时间和精力限制，我只做了三种着色大类。包含原始款式在内所有五种款式都有三种着色方式：light，middle，dark。
[*]light对应浅色地图着色比如Blue Grass Recolor（10635），middle对应中性色地图着色如Soft Slow Seasons（23095），dark对应深色地图着色如DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour（5255）。
[*]模组包中默认的是middle着色，出于时间和精力限制，我没有（也尚且不会）制作对应的着色切换代码部分，而是将light和dark着色一并放入模组包，可以根据需要自行替换assets中的素材（记得assets中文件名必须为Furniture！）
[*]此模组为公开标准版，不包含图片3中所展示的较为华丽的大型部件。这些部件将作为我的小红书粉丝专享部分，仅在我的小红书上发布。
[/list]
[center][b][size=4]如何获得这些家具：[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]罗宾处可买家具目录。
[*]通过Happy Home Designer（19675）列表。
[*]通过CJB获取。
[/list]


如果您喜欢我的mod，可以请我喝杯咖啡？我也接受定制mod服务的咨询。
也欢迎在小红书上关注我@山茶花与紫丁香，我的一些非公开模组也会在这里分享。

[center][size=5]最后：
倒卖模组者死全家。[/size][/center]
